cli.help:
hdrctl — Hydra ETL Control CLI

Manage your declarative ETL pipelines with ease.

 
Main commands:
  run       Execute an ETL pipeline
  init      Create a new job from a template
  test      Validate a job configuration
  validate  Strict YAML DSL validation
  list      List jobs in current directory
help.run.docstring:
PATH  Job directory (default: current directory)

 
Examples:
  hydra run .
  hydra run jobs/daily_revenue -vv
  hydra run . --dry-run
  hydra run . --on-success "curl https://hooks.slack.com/..."
  hydra run . -s sources_alt.yaml -d conf/destinations_prod.yaml
help.init.docstring:
Available templates:
  basic     — Simple CSV (default)
  csv       — CSV with sample data
  mysql     — MySQL/MariaDB with upsert
  postgres  — PostgreSQL with ON CONFLICT
  api       — REST Web API with pagination
  mongodb   — MongoDB with schema auto-detection

 
Examples:
  hydra init my_job
  hydra init my_job --template mysql
  hydra init my_job --template csv --force
help.test.docstring:
Examples:
  hydra test .
  hydra test jobs/daily_revenue
  hydra test . --only-sources
  hydra test . --only-transform
  hydra test . -s sources_alt.yaml -d conf/destinations_prod.yaml
help.validate.docstring:
Examples:
  hydra validate .
  hydra validate jobs/daily_revenue --strict
  hydra validate . -s sources_alt.yaml -p conf/pipeline_prod.yaml
help.list.docstring:
Examples:
  hydra list
  hydra list jobs/
workflow.list.none_found: No workflow.yaml found in this directory.
help.workflow.docstring:
Manage and execute Hydra workflows (multi-job DAG).

 
Examples:
  hydra workflow run ./workflow.yaml
  hydra workflow validate ./workflow.yaml
  hydra workflow list .
help.workflow.run.docstring:
PATH  Path to workflow.yaml (default: ./workflow.yaml)

 
Examples:
  hydra workflow run ./workflow.yaml
  hydra workflow run workflows/daily.yaml
help.workflow.validate.docstring:
Validates the workflow manifest without executing it.

 
Examples:
  hydra workflow validate ./workflow.yaml
help.workflow.list.docstring:
Examples:
  hydra workflow list .
  hydra workflow list workflows/
workflow.init.exists: File '{path}' already exists. Use --force to overwrite.
help.workflow.init.docstring:
Available templates:
  basic      — Sequential: job_a → job_b → notify
  parallel   — Fan-out/fan-in: extract → [a, b] → load
  scheduled  — With cron trigger
  notify     — With webhook action

 
Examples:
  hydra workflow init my_workflow
  hydra workflow init daily --template scheduled
  hydra workflow init etl --template parallel
help.workflow.init.name: Workflow file name (without .yaml)
help.workflow.init.template: Template to use (basic, parallel, scheduled, notify)
